result.question: Why is Micah angry?

readings.answer: Because they took the gods he had made and his priest.
readings.support: You took the gods I had made, and my priest

assessments.reason: Directly matches Micah’s stated grievance: “You took the gods I had made, and my priest” (18:24), which identifies the Danites’ theft of his idols and priest as the cause of his anger.
“What else do I have?” (18:24) reasonably paraphrases his anger as stemming from having nothing left after the theft, a consequence of the same event the key names.
